__comment: starter dashboard for the alloy/loki stack (plan §9). panels query the container's structured json logs; adjust the loki datasource uid and the container label selector to match the nas. the tuning panels (scores, rejections, token spend per source) read the judge/poll/pipeline subsystem events.
title: tattoo

panels.title: items judged vs passed per run

targets.expr: avg by (source) (avg_over_time({container="tattoo"} | json | subsystem = `judge` | msg = `triaged` | unwrap score [1d]))

panels.title: acquisition method per item (bad extraction shows up here)

targets.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({container="tattoo"} | json | subsystem = `acquire` | msg = `content stored` [1d]))
